getpath_resolve_asset: get the absolute path to an asset file by providing a relative path or asset name
setroot_change_assets_dir: set the assets root directory to a custom path for resolving asset locations
getroot_get_assets_root: get the current assets root directory path with auto-detection if not yet set
reset_clear_assets_root: reset the AssetManager root to None so it will auto-detect on next access
getpath_batch_resolve: resolve a list of relative asset paths to their absolute paths in one call
